context.process_name: Debt Investment Economics: Loan Workbook, Yields, PIK, OID & Warrants
context.objective: Document how this process works, including controls and what remains unresolved.

turns.text: After FA-09 purchase setup is complete and the client sends final executed loan documents, we build the debt-investment workbook. It supports monthly interest and amortization, plus event-driven updates to the loan.
Talk me through how you build the debt-investment workbook from the executed loan documents.

The preparer records the contract terms with page citations, ties opening balances and builds an Excel schedule through maturity with stubs, cash interest, PIK principal and OID or warrant amortization where applicable. An independent checker recalculates key terms and period-one principal, PIK and OID before anyone relies on the workbook.
What kinds of loan events lead you to update the workbook, and how does the update get initiated?

The client or investment team confirms new draws, tranches, amendments, rate changes, cash/PIK elections, prepayment or default. For an amendment we preserve the pre-change copy, identify the effective date, split periods and compare before and after for independent review. The workbook cannot be extended past contractual maturity without written direction.
What does the independent checker compare the key terms against when recalculating them?

The checker independently extracts the material terms from the executed documents, verifies the document citations and recalculates the initial build. Each monthly accrual run compares suggested Allvue lines against the Excel schedule, documenting rounding. Zero unexplained difference across principal, income, cash, amortization and GL/TB is the close control. The checker signs and the period version is locked. The formal process owner and JE approval route are unconfirmed.
When a monthly comparison shows an unexplained difference, what happens before the period version can be signed and locked?

The preparer classifies and investigates the variance against actual cash, terms, elections and the workbook. Unexplained differences keep posting and reporting close on hold. Open items are resolved or assigned in the variance log. The Accounting or Fund Team posts reviewed entries only after the controls; legal or tax/accounting advisers decide unclear nonstandard treatment.
What is the practical impact when an unexplained variance keeps posting and reporting close on hold?

Posting remains on hold, so the GL/TB and financial reporting cannot rely on the amounts. Wrong terms or formulas can misstate income and principal across periods. The results feed FA-13 quarterly workbook, FA-14 analytical review and FA-15 audit support; no standard dollar impact or duration is provided.
If the independent checker finds a discrepancy in the initial build, what happens before the workbook can be relied on?
